headline: Zoning changes, parking rules, school roof bonds, and a no-confidence resolution on Mayor DePeña top the agenda.
summary: The council will hold public hearings on zoning changes and utility pole installations, then review many parking and handicapped parking requests, committee reports on housing redevelopment parcels, school roof bond authorizations, and new business including police technology and grant expenditures.
